Corollary
[Dirichlet solvability on a ball] 1. ch6:6.9\group gt-ch06 Under Theorem 6.8 with $\Omega =B$ a ball, the Dirichlet problem has a unique $C^{2,\alpha }(\bar B)$ solution for $f\in C^\alpha (\bar B)$ and $\varphi \in C^{2,\alpha }(\bar B)$.
